seo.title: IIT R – ONE — Priyank Savaliya
seo.description: Re-designing IIT Roorkee's Academic Information System into one unified mobile app that simplifies the daily tasks of university students.

cover.title: Re-Designing an Academic Info. System platform to simplify daily task of university students

image.alt: IIT R – ONE cover: illustration of the IIT Roorkee main building above a river and pine forest, with the IIT Roorkee and Department of Design logos

blocks.heading: Scope
blocks.body: The scope of this project focuses on understanding and redesigning the Academic Information System (AIS) at IIT Roorkee from a student-centered perspective. The goal is to map and improve all major touchpoints that students interact with throughout their academic journey. These interactions range from onboarding to academic and extracurricular processes, and finally to placements and alumni relations.

blocks.heading: Features covered
blocks.body: Registration, timetable, grades, leave/OD requests, resources, notifications, exams, admin forms

blocks.heading: Objectives
items: To identify and document key student interactions within the AIS ecosystem (academic, administrative, and extracurricular).
To uncover pain points, inefficiencies, and emotional responses associated with these interactions.
To evaluate how existing digital tools and portals support or hinder students’ academic and administrative activities.
To define user needs, motivations, and expectations from an ideal academic information experience.
To generate insights and opportunity areas for creating a more unified, accessible, and engaging AIS experience.

blocks.heading: About IIT Roorkee
blocks.body: IIT Roorkee is a public technical university in Roorkee, Uttarakhand, India, renowned as a leading engineering and research institution. Established in 1847 as the Roorkee College and later becoming the Thomason College of Civil Engineering, it is one of India's oldest technical institutes. It offers bachelor's, postgraduate, and doctoral degrees in a wide range of engineering, science, and humanities disciplines.

blocks.heading: What is it?
blocks.body: Academic Information system refers to the various channels through which all academic/extracurricular day to day information reaches a student/faculty. System that enables this exchange of information between the students/faculty/staff.

blocks.alt: Key channels: Instagram, Gmail, WhatsApp, Microsoft Teams, LinkedIn and Channel i, plus the Institute Lecture Hall and Conference Complex Booking System, the Online Academic Support and Information System, the Academic Affairs Office and the Ph.D. Portal

blocks.alt: Persona: Pranit Mishra, 25, Masters student living in Ravindra Bhawan, IIT Roorkee, with decent technical ability. Quote: “I have a tight schedule I don’t want to spend half an hour filling forms.” Personality: goal oriented, learn more, skilled. Goal: quick, hassle free completion of required academic tasks. Needs: intuitive workflow and way finding; easy identification of the application for each task without memorising. Frustrations: OTP logins, un-intuitive UI and un-indicative way finding; tedious processes; often has to ask others to figure out the process.

blocks.body: How Might We help IIT Roorkee students to easily access and manage all their academic platforms through a single unified mobile application from using multiple disconnected and hard-to-navigate portals for different academic tasks to a single, seamless, and user-friendly mobile app interface integrating all academic services so as to improve accessibility, convenience, and overall academic efficiency for students despite institutional data integration challenges and varying platform compatibility

blocks.alt: Illustration of characters on staircases around a spinning crystal, celebrating moving from many portals to one

Impact versus effort matrix of sticky notes: high impact, low effort ideas include real-time timetable notifications, assignment deadline alerts, easier login and an AI advisor; high impact, high effort ideas include a unified dashboard, integrating portals and a mobile-first platform

groups.body: IITR has multiple platform problem which later leads to varied iconography, design system, user flows, etc.

By introducing IITR-One an app that solves this problem by unifying the multiple platforms we unify the design synergy at the same time solving the major user experience and user problems we encountered.

image.alt: IIT R One splash screen on an iPhone

blocks.alt: Information architecture: app opens to the home page, which branches into important latest news, personal academics, noticeboard, attendance, subject channels, and placement and internships, each with their sub-pages

Personal academic information — covers attendance, assignments, subject materials, class dates and venues in 4 clicks. Notice boards and announcements — 2 step user flow with announcement filters: All, PIC, General, Cultural, Sports, Maintenance, tech events, workshops, Events

Attendance — 3 step user flow for applying attendance by dragging right during the current class. Placement and internships — 3 step process for viewing placements, ongoing applications, opportunities and news & alerts
